description:
HouseToSpot is a modern property search app designed to make finding your next home simple, intuitive, and visually engaging. Instead of browsing endless lists, users can explore real estate directly on an interactive map, making it easier to understand locations, neighborhoods, and nearby amenities at a glance.

With HouseToSpot, you can search properties by city and instantly see available listings pinned on a dynamic map. Each property is easy to access, giving you quick insights into pricing, location, and key details without unnecessary complexity.

The app focuses on a clean, user-friendly experience, helping users:

Discover properties in their desired city
Navigate listings through an interactive map interface
Quickly compare locations and housing options
Save time by visualizing results instead of scrolling through static lists

Whether you’re looking to rent, buy, or simply explore the market, HouseToSpot provides a smarter, map-based approach to property discovery.
